    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(grid)
    if not h:
        return out
    w = len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    min_prefix = max(3, w // 2)
    for a in range(h):
        for b in range(a + 1, h):
            ra, rb = grid[a], grid[b]
            k = 0
            while k < w and ra[k] == rb[k]:
                k += 1
            if k < min_prefix or k == w:
                continue
            sa, sb = ra[k:], rb[k:]
            if all(v == bg for v in sa) and len(set(sb)) == 1 and sb[0] != bg:
                out[a][k:] = [1] * (w-k)
            elif all(v == bg for v in sb) and len(set(sa)) == 1 and sa[0] != bg:
                out[b][k:] = [1] * (w-k)
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source); ns={}; exec(source,ns)
O1=ns['transform'](D1)
O2=ns['transform'](D2)
